description: A shell script containing automated tests for Git push operations under various scenarios, including standard push, atomic push, non-fast-forward push, forced push, and cleanup steps of Git refs.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, running the provided shell commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting failure, running the provided shell commands.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual and expected output for validation.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Compares local Git refs with expected references.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Processes raw Git output into a stable, user-friendly format.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Formats expected output and saves it for comparison.

methods.name: filter_out_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Filters shell output to remove non-essential differences.
